beginners.title: Complete beginners
beginners.description: Never touched code in your life? No worries! We’re here to help you succeed, even if you have zero experience or understanding of how programming works.

careerChangers.title: Career changers
careerChangers.description: Always wanted to try yourself in tech but never had the chance? This is the perfect opportunity to land your dream job with guidance from industry experts.

graduates.title: Recent graduates
graduates.description: Feel like your degree only gave you the basics? We’ll equip you with the most in-demand skills to help you grow into a true industry professional.

hero.description: Hands-on projects, expert mentorship, and full support at every step - everything you need to make your transition into IT confident and stress-free.

steps.title: How the Learning Works
steps.description: At ProCoding, everything is clear and practical! Our entire course is written by real developers and educators working in the US — they know what will be in demand tomorrow. Our mentors designed the program to make programming easy for you: week by week, without chaos.

list.title: 1. Intro Stage

list.title: 2. Theory
list.description: HTML, CSS, JS, algorithms, Git, core tech.

list.title: 4. Job Prep
list.description: Soft skills, LinkedIn, CV, mock interviews.

guarantee.title: Transparent Terms & Money-Back Guarantee
guarantee.description: If the format doesn’t work for you — we’ll refund your payment within 30 days. Join and try out our program to make sure it’s truly the right fit for you.

readyWork.title: Your Outcome After Graduation
readyWork.description: By the time you graduate, you'll have a strong portfolio packed with real-world personal and team projects — a powerful tool to impress future employers. You'll feel confident using the technologies and workflows you've mastered throughout the bootcamp. Plus, our career coaches and HR specialists will support you every step of the way — from crafting a standout resume and LinkedIn profile to preparing for interviews and navigating your job search.

steps.title: Web Developer Junior+
steps.description: That will be your title after completing the program. You’ll also receive a certificate from us.

steps.title: Portfolio
steps.description: By the end of the course, you’ll have 3 solid projects in your portfolio — personal and team-based — to showcase your skills to future employers.

steps.title: CV & LinkedIn
steps.description: We’ll help you craft a market-ready CV, optimize your LinkedIn profile, and prepare all the tools you need to stand out to potential employers.

steps.title: Interview Preparation
steps.description: In every class, your instructors will highlight what’s important for technical interviews. You’ll also go through a dedicated module focused entirely on preparing you for real-world interviews.

instructors.title: Meet Our Team
instructors.description: Throughout your learning journey, you’ll receive professional support from experienced industry experts. In every class, our instructors will guide you through the material, help you understand key concepts, and support you with your lab work if you run into any difficulties. Once your labs are submitted, our technical assistants will review them and provide valuable feedback.
instructors.kate: 6 years in IT education. She built this course to include only what truly matters — practical knowledge that delivers real results.
instructors.anastasia: Switched from being a medical doctor to software development in just one year. Three years later, she became a team lead — now she helps others follow the same path.
instructors.konstantin: Instructors explain not just the "how" but also the "why" to foster deeper understanding and critical thinking.
instructors.angelina: Always there to keep you updated and supported behind the scenes — she makes sure everything runs smoothly.

cards.title: On-Demand Tech Stack

cards.title: Real-World Experience

cards.title: Practice-Driven Learning

cards.title: Career Support
cards.description: We don’t just teach programming — we guide you through job search strategies, best practices, and support you every step of the way.

cards.title: Convenient Format

cards.title: Supportive Community
cards.description: You’re not alone. Our team of mentors, tech assistants, and fellow students will support you both technically and emotionally — to stay motivated, focused, and inspired.

curriculum.title: Curriculum Overview
curriculum.subtitle: We’ve designed this bootcamp to be intensive, yet perfectly paced for beginners. Every week, you’ll receive theoretical lessons on the platform, get clear explanations from experts during live classes, and join live coding and code-along sessions. You will also put your knowledge into action during pair programming labs — because we believe the best way to learn is by doing.
curriculum.subtitleShort: We’ve designed this bootcamp to be intensive, yet perfectly paced for beginners.

intro.label: Intro
intro.title: Introductory Module
intro.content: Set up your work environment and install necessary programs for a smooth start to learning. Familiarize yourself with basics of key technologies and core concepts to make understanding the main material easier and more effective.

module1.label: Module 1
module1.title: Module 1: HTML, CSS, JS
module1.content: Get familiar with the fundamental building blocks of websites. Begin your programming journey by learning key concepts and principles. Create your first web pages with proper styling and interactive user experiences.

module2.label: Module 2
module2.title: Module 2: Backend
module2.content: Learn how to build fully functional web applications that can work with and store data. Create apps that save user information, deliver personalized features, and efficiently handle requests — essential skills for working with any data-driven system.

module3.label: Module 3
module3.title: Module 3: React
module3.content: Begin working with cutting-edge technologies and best practices in React development, mastering tools and approaches in demand in the industry. Learn to write clean, elegant code that follows principles of clarity and efficiency. You’ll be writing code that not only works but is also readable, maintainable, and meets quality standards.

module4.label: Module 4
module4.title: Additional technologies and Technical interview preparation
module4.content: Familiarize yourself with technologies often required in the industry, making it easier to adapt during onboarding at a new job. Learn how to handle technical interviews and discover the most common questions asked.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We’ve gathered answers to the most common questions our students ask before starting. Can’t find what you’re looking for? Just message us — we’re here to help.
faq.a1: The course lasts 6 months. Classes take place two evenings a week and on Saturdays from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, all online. This flexible format makes it easy to combine learning with your job and personal life.
faq.a2: It’s designed for beginners, career changers, self-taught learners who need structure, and recent graduates looking to get job-ready skills.
faq.a3: You’ll master HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, and more — along with modern tools and workflows. You'll also learn agile methodologies like Agile, Scrum, and Kanban.
faq.q4: Is it all theory, or will there be hands-on practice?
faq.a4: There’s a lot of practice! After every module, you’ll complete lab assignments and mini-projects. At the end of the course, you’ll build a team project for your portfolio.
faq.q5: What will I have by the end of the course?
faq.a5: A professional portfolio with 2–3 projects, Junior+ level web development skills, a polished resume and LinkedIn profile, interview readiness, and a bootcamp graduation certificate.
faq.q6: Do you help with job search?
faq.a6: Yes! Our career team helps you every step of the way — from writing your resume and preparing for interviews to connecting you with partner employers.
faq.q7: Is there support during the course?
faq.a7: Absolutely. You’ll be guided by mentors, instructors, and technical assistants. You can always ask questions and get help with any topic or technical issue.
faq.q8: What if the format doesn’t work for me?
faq.a8: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you realize the course isn’t the right fit within the first month, we’ll refund your payment.
faq.q9: What is the class format like?
faq.a9: Classes are fully online and use interactive formats — live coding, code-alongs, challenges, discussions, and stand-ups. No boring screen shares — only engaging, hands-on learning.
